name: ad-ldap
description: Active Directory administration over LDAPS for Claude Code: an MCP server (FastMCP + ldap3) with 15 tools, admin agents, slash commands, a safety skill, and a guard that refuses any AD write until the identical call has been dry-run, then asks you. Headline workflow: mass-assign computer managedBy from description-held owner names via a dry-run plan/review/apply loop.

server.title: Domain controller
server.description: Hostname or ldaps:// URI of a domain controller, e.g. dc01.example.com

bind_user.title: Service account
bind_user.description: UPN (svc-ldap@example.com) or full DN of the bind account

bind_password.title: Service account password
bind_password.description: Stored in your OS keychain, never in settings.json

port.title: LDAPS port
port.description: 636, or 3269 for the Global Catalog over SSL

ca_certs.title: CA bundle path (optional)
ca_certs.description: PEM file for the DC's certificate chain. Leave blank to use the system trust store.

tls_validate.title: Validate the DC's certificate
tls_validate.description: Turn off only for a self-signed lab DC
